title: Understanding MSE Minimization
text: When trying to minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) using a constant model, think about how the model's prediction relates to the actual data points. What statistical measure best represents the center of the data in terms of minimizing squared differences?

title: Exploring the Median
text: Consider the role of the median in a dataset. Does it minimize the sum of squared differences from the data points?

title: Mean vs. Median
text: The mean is often used to minimize the sum of squared differences. How does this compare to the median, which minimizes the sum of absolute differences?
